analyst.pregame_mechanism: Dallas Flagg delivered 33 and team won 116–94 over a depleted Warriors squad, breaking a three-game slide; Mavericks 6–2 at home entering game. Clippers 4–10 and have zero road wins in current preview; Garland and Brook Lopez scored 23 each against Spurs but Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal OUT undermine creation depth. DAL Flagg/Irving secondary penetration plus defensive help opportunities is opponent-specific edge, not just records.

analyst.pregame_mechanism: Memphis has scored 136 at WAS, 124 at CLE and 126 vs GSW across recent matches; its 15/35 threes vs GSW may not repeat but Coward/wing initiation shows multiple outlets. Grizzlies had won eight straight road games according to current preview. Minnesota, without Edwards and DiVincenzo, scored only 99 vs NYK and relies on Gobert shell and LaMelo/Ayo for creation. Lean toward MEM perimeter creation despite Minnesota rim protection.

Memphis Boozer/Grant/Pippen out, Jerome PROBABLE; one wounded roster attacking one of the best rim protections. A tight low-confidence side, not strong lock.
